review.notes: Full token-level diff of all 20 physical PDF pages against the OCR markdown, plus a structural read of all headings, tables and code-free fences (no unbalanced fences). Math notation differences (LaTeX subscripts, tag numbering) are equivalent renderings, not defects. Page 12 Table 6 was rendered at 300 dpi: the third column group prints 3DB (OCR wrote SDB) and the PromptHMR citation prints Wang et al. (2025c) (OCR wrote 2026c); all compared table values matched. The PDF itself prints 'a video transition effect as used to fade-in' on physical p.13, so the OCR wording is faithful and left unchanged. The arXiv stamp on p.1 and axis ticks ('100', '100.0') inside Figure 9 on p.13 are figure/stamp text, not body droppage. The \_ escapes in prose (pose\_3d:very\_hard, viewpoint:topdown\_view) render to the exact underscores the PDF prints; the HTML table rows use unescaped underscores consistently, so no patch.

patches.evidence: Rendered physical p.12, Table 6 header: the third column group is printed '3DB' over PVE/MPJPE/PA-MPJPE; OCR transcribed S. Verified at 300 dpi crop. Same document body and caption both use 3DB.

Rendered physical p.12, Table 6 header: PromptHMR citation prints 'Wang et al. (2025c)' (visually verified at 300 dpi); OCR misread the 5 as 6. The body text (OCR section 8.6 and PDF p.11) cites 'Wang et al. (2025c)'.
